bio: A “hidden oasis of peace, tranquillity and joy” right in the centre of Ljubljana, just a stone’s throw from the city’s bustling riverside promenade, Shambala serves Asian cuisine amid an Asian-influenced decor that is attractive without being overly decorative. The dishes on the menu (meat, fish and seafood, and vegetarian) are inspired by countries all over Asia, from Japan to Thailand and Vietnam. The desserts feature more European options such as panna cotta, which is served with a mango and date sauce that gives it a more exotic flavour....
